summary: Defines two SIP header fields, Resource-Priority and Accept-Resource-Priority, for communicating resource priority. They can influence how SIP user agents, such as gateways and IP phones, and SIP proxies behave, but not how IP routers forward packets. It is standards-track.

eli5.summary: Some calls matter more, such as emergency ones. This lets a call carry a priority tag so phone gear knows which calls to take care of first.
